description: Full-client administration for multi-business Team workspaces AND customer accounts. List or create businesses, inspect one business, update country/currency/accounting linkage, choose Stripe/PayStack/PayFast availability and sandbox mode, and invite or update role-based members. For customer accounts: list_customers (each with allocated workers, relationship stage, outstanding balance and open work), get_customer (full detail: invoices, payments, plans and work-in-progress with task progress), list_customer_workers (who can be allocated), allocate_worker / unassign_worker (assign a team member as lead or support on a customer), set_customer_stage (lead, active, delivering, retained, dormant, lost), and link_project (tie a Plan project to a customer so its progress shows on the account). AI PLANNER: plan_job takes a plain-language brief (optionally for a customer) and returns a proposed, sequenced task plan with a suggested worker for each task, balanced by current workload — nothing is created yet. After the user reviews/edits and approves, call apply_plan with confirm=true and the tasks to create a customer-linked project and drop each task into its worker's inbox (in-app + email). JOB COSTING: get_costing_settings returns the team markup and AI asset unit prices (image, video_second, voiceover_minute, ai_copy_page) plus configured worker hourly cost/charge rates; estimate_job_cost takes tasks (with estimated_hours + assignee_id) and assets, and returns the human cost, AI/asset cost, total cost, a suggested customer price with markup, and the profit/margin — so a job can be quoted correctly. CRM PIPELINE: list_deals (open opportunities by stage with values and weighted totals), get_deal (one deal with its full activity history), create_deal / update_deal (title, customer, owner, value, probability, stage, expected close, next step), win_deal (close won, and with create_invoice=true plus confirm=true raise the invoice on the team book), log_activity / complete_activity / list_activities (calls, emails, meetings, notes and follow-up tasks against a deal or customer), and forecast (weighted pipeline plus already-won revenue per month). TARGETS: get_targets returns each team or per-worker target for the period with its LIVE actual, attainment, pace and days left; set_target sets a number for a metric (revenue, deals_won, deal_value_won, pipeline_value, activities, calls, meetings, tasks_completed, invoices_sent) for a month/quarter/year; leaderboard ranks every active worker on any metric. Actuals are always computed from real payments, deals, activities and completed tasks — never stored or typed in. Team owners/admins may only narrow settings below platform-wide controls. Secret gateway keys are never accepted or returned. RATE CARD: get_rate_card returns what the business charges for each piece of standard work at basic/standard/premium plus what it costs and the margin, and what an hour of each role costs; seed_rate_card lays down a starter card; set_rate_card_item / set_role_rate change a price; price_from_rate_card prices a job from chosen items and a tier and returns price, cost, profit, margin and hours — so a worker quotes from the card instead of guessing. LEADS: log_outreach records an expo, calling session or networking morning with its cost and how many people were spoken to; capture_leads records the cards that came back in one call and refuses one already on the book rather than creating a rival record; list_leads surfaces who has never been called and whose follow-up is overdue; log_lead_contact records an actual attempt; convert_lead promotes a qualified lead into a customer contact and a pipeline deal, crediting whoever captured it as introducer; lead_performance gives the per-worker and per-source overview; set_company_profile and set_person record what the business does, its size and budget, what it spends now, its competitors and the named people who decide, sign and can block. VISIBILITY: leads and customer intelligence default to the own setting, where a worker sees only their own records and their reporting line (set_reporting_line) and only owners/admins see the whole book — so a freelancer cannot take the customer list with them. QUOTATIONS: a price offered to a customer is a quotation (QUO- or QT-), never an invoice. create_quotation raises it on the team book, send_quotation issues it, accept_quotation converts it into the INV- that asks for the money (optionally billing a deposit percentage) and links the two documents. Never raise an invoice for work the customer has not yet agreed to. TERRITORY FARMING: a territory is an industry in an area being worked systematically. create_territory names the patch; find_prospects searches it and marks anything already held by a teammate, because the same listing must never be farmed twice; add_prospects puts them on the list; research_prospect reads the website belonging to that prospect and keeps what it finds; build_prospect_demo forks the closest-matching template and rebrands it as their business, so the first thing you send is a working site of theirs rather than a pitch about yourself (needs confirm=true, it raises a real draft website); seed_sequence/set_sequence define the ladder of outreach steps; start_sequence puts a prospect on it; due_list returns who to contact today with the wording already filled in; log_touch records an attempt that actually happened and moves the prospect on, closing them when they say no rather than chasing on a timer; promote_prospect turns a prospect who answered into a lead. territory_performance reports attempts, replies and attempts-per-reply per worker. A prospect nobody actually contacted can never be reported as worked. TRACKED LINKS: create_team_link gives any member their own short /r/ link for a named post, without marketing-admin rights and without access to any campaign or ad budget; each link carries its own utm_content so two posts never merge; list_team_links reports clicks, signups, paying customers, revenue, revenue per click and commission per person. This administrative tool is excluded from the OpenAI review profile.
